_note: THE DURABLE PREFLIGHT ALLOWANCE. Committed on purpose: an in-process counter is reset by the next process, and the whole point of an allowance is that it is not. capture_incentive_manifest.py seeds from this file and writes back to it, so a re-dispatch of the capture workflow resumes from what was already spent instead of starting again at zero.
_scope: PRE-DEPLOY, out of band. This is NOT the observation run's eight-request row budget, which is held in Postgres by bettor_live_control.reserve() and is untouched by anything here.

attempts.outcome: URLError -- the egress proxy refused CONNECT to gateway.polymarket.us with 403 (policy denial). The request never reached the venue.

_why_blocked_attempts_still_count: A CONNECT the proxy refused consumed none of the venue's rate budget, so on a narrow reading these two were free. They are counted anyway. The allowance exists to bound how many times we reach for this endpoint, not only how many times we succeed, and an accounting rule that forgives every failure is one that never binds. Recording them as spent is the conservative reading and it is the one in force.
_raise_20260922: CAP RAISED 6 -> 10, authorized 2026-09-22. NOT A RESET: `spent` stays at 6 and all six prior attempts are preserved below, so the four new units are the ONLY ones available and a seventh attempt would have to come out of them. Scope: one fresh manifest targeting ET date 2026-09-23, at most four additional public HTTP attempts INCLUDING pagination and retries. The 2026-09-22 capture spent one unit per page over four pages, so four units buys four pages and nothing more -- if the board has grown, the capture will exhaust the allowance mid-pagination and refuse rather than silently return a short board.
